summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 21, 2026 press release announcing a proposed private offering of US$500 million aggregate principal amount of senior secured notes due 2031, in a Rule 144A/Regulation S placement exempt from registration. Net proceeds are earmarked to repay and terminate the roughly US$120.9 million Appian Credit Facility, prefund a five-payment interest reserve account, and advance the Cariboo Gold Project in British Columbia. Notes are guaranteed by Barkerville Gold Mines Ltd. and secured by a first-priority lien. Pricing, coupon and terms remain market-dependent, making this a routine debt refinancing rather than a special situation. Watch pricing, coupon and any construction-cost overruns or drawdown risk at Cariboo.
